overall_assessment: All 28 packet courses were reviewed: four contain course-search listings and 21 contain a later-year or later-semester plan, including five of eight random controls. The sampled long/dup_code flags identify real fallback listings and all 16 sampled year flags identify real mismatches; the year pre-pass misses mismatches when an unselected semester-menu entry matches the offering academic year, or when only the semester differs. Actual plan sections and facts appear complete and readable, with no demonstrated missing content or extraction truncation, but status notices and semester-selection menus remain in the text.

findings.description: All 24 actual-plan pages include the Startsemestre version-selection list, and 21 also include a Statusmelding banner with an unpublished-semester or language notice. These are recurring interface text. Even otherwise-correct controls such as 4PM791 and SOA1001 include unselected years alongside the applicable teaching semester. The junk pre-pass does not recognize these phrases. Course titles, course codes and the actual teaching-semester facts are legitimate metadata and should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The INN .content-inner selector has no exclude or post_fn for status notices or the semester-selection widget. R/institution_config.R marks fieldset.semesters-top as facts, and page_fulltext() includes facts by default, so the whole picker is serialized.
findings.suggested_fix: Add INN exclusions for fieldset.semesters-top and the status-message block, retaining the course header and facts list including Undervisningssemestre/Teaching semester. Read selected-version and fallback information from the raw HTML before excluding interface elements, so year validation remains available.
